Problem: test/zaq/channels/delivery/plan_validation_test.exs property "planner output preserves every original index across fixed groups" repeats index-preservation coverage in test/zaq/channels/delivery/attachments_test.exs property "packing preserves every original index exactly once and respects known ceilings", using a narrower generator. Its distinct contribution is Plan.validate/2.

Agreed change: add the Plan.validate/2 assertion to the existing packing property and remove the duplicate property. Retain distinct malformed-reference, dependency-cycle and invalid-edit validation tests and their necessary helpers. Preserve existing broader size/count/ceiling generators and assertions. Other executor, adapter compatibility and Engine suites have distinct responsibilities and remain separate; no broad test restructuring.

Approval: user explicitly approved this exact consolidation/removal after explanation. This satisfies the existing-test behavior approval gate only for moving the distinct validation assertion and removing redundant coverage; unrelated assertion weakening or changes are not authorized.

Acceptance: generated plans from the existing packing property pass Plan.validate/2 using the original attachment count; every original index still appears exactly once and existing ceiling assertions remain. Distinct malformed-plan rejection coverage is unchanged. Run the affected attachments and plan-validation suites and required issue validation checks.

Action reuse assessment: test-only consolidation; reuse existing generators, fixtures and Plan.validate/2, no production operation or new Action. No new test module or duplicate helper is needed.

Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/testing-approach.md and docs/code-quality.md before implementation. Follow validation lifecycle. This decision turn records agreed work only; no test source changed.
